$Comment: Snowman henchman summoned by the Ice King with the Gunters (2026-10-21, concept 'SNOW MEN': slow, his hug freezes at once, melts after a while). Variant of vanilla Template_Predator like AT_Gunter_Minion. Slow (MaxSpeed 3), weak (40 HP); the hug (Root_AT_Snowman_Hug, Fox_Bite window) does 3 damage and freezes 2 s (AT_Snowman_Hug_Freeze, freeze guard respected). AT_Snowman_Melting in CombatConfig EntityEffects melts him in about 20 s (2 fire damage a second). Model AT_Snowman (placeholder). 2026-10-21 (playtest: they walk too fast): MaxSpeed 2 (was 3), ChaseRelativeSpeed and CombatMovingRelativeSpeed 0.8 (were 1). 2026-10-21: 2.5 blocks tall now (art): AttackDistance 2.6 (was 1.8) and CombatBehaviorDistance 5 (4) to match the longer hug reach (AT_Snowman_Hug EndDistance 3).
